huntBeats.text: A man, maybe 40s has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Ines drew big heart-shaped leaves on stalks, like elephant ears in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

Booker spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
💡 The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — THAT's what Booker was describing. Burdock. It clicks like a key turning.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
"Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

🔥 The fire settles. Ines has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at on
"Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

Deeper knowledge: Muscadine Grapes. Uses: sugar, resveratrol. Leaves are edible (like grape leaves). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: thick-skinned wild grapes, sweet-tart; bait: fallen fruit baits traps well.
✨ Ability gained: Lucky Rock (L1). Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
📖 LEARNED: Nocturnal Patterns (Level 2). Hushpuppies hunt in packs after dark. Highbeam Deer freeze in the black between trees — that shine is them aiming. Moths come to any light you make.
